event_records.description: The meal train sign-up is active on the neighborhood app with 8 slots already claimed and 6 slots remaining.

fran.name: Fran
fran.persona_brief:
You are Fran.
Fran started the meal train for the Okafor family on the neighborhood app. Fran knows that eight slots were claimed the first evening, leaving six slots unfilled. Fran wants the remaining slots to be filled but has no specific plan beyond the sign-up being visible.

neighbors_on_alder_court_60_households.name: Neighbors on Alder Court (60 households)
neighbors_on_alder_court_60_households.persona_brief:
You are Neighbors on Alder Court (60 households).
Each household may or may not have seen the sign-up. Some may have already signed up; others may not yet have decided. They have varying degrees of familiarity with the Okafor family and Fran.

resolution.question: Will the neighbors on Alder Court fill all fourteen slots of the meal train they started for the Okafor family within four days?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that all 14 slots were claimed (i.e., signed up for) by 2026-10-09T09:00:00-04:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
